instruction: Please convert the receipt image located at /home/user/OIP.jpg into PDF format and save it as "billing.pdf" on the desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task converts OIP.jpg to PDF as 'billing.pdf' on Desktop. Evaluator checks /home/user/Desktop/billing.pdf exists, has 1 page, size > 10KB, and contains image.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all requirements of the instruction
File location check: Verifies billing.pdf exists at /home/user/Desktop/
Page count check: Confirms PDF has exactly 1 page (appropriate for single image conversion)
Content verification: Checks file size > 10KB to ensure non-empty PDF
Image presence check: Verifies PDF contains actual image content by searching for /XObject with /Subtype == /Image
Postconfig includes 2-second sleep to allow file operations to complete
Getter (get_vm_file) can successfully retrieve the file from VM
Metric logic is sound and will execute correctly at runtime
All verifiable aspects of image-to-PDF conversion task are covered
